textCase.description: Sets the letter case of your text, whatever case it was typed in. Only how it looks changes; the text itself is kept as typed.
textCase.title: Text Case

textCaseScope.description: Which text the Text Case applies to: body paragraphs only, or all text including navigation, links and buttons. Headings have their own setting.
textCaseScope.title: Text Case Applies To

headingCase.description: Sets the letter case of headings and titles, whatever case they were typed in. Takes priority over Text Case.
headingCase.title: Heading Case

typeScale.description: The size of your text and how much bigger headings and titles are than body text. Default makes headings large and dramatic. Compact uses slightly smaller body text and keeps headings smaller. Minimal makes headings only a little bigger than body text.
typeScale.title: Type Scale

showSearch.description: Allows users to search your website
showSearch.title: Enable Search

showLogin.description: Allows users to login to your website
showLogin.title: Enable Login

showHeroImage.description: Shows your hero image on the home page
showHeroImage.title: Show Hero Image

imageDuotone.description: Tints the images in event, product and artist listings in your Image Tint Color (your primary color unless you pick one): shadows take the color, highlights stay white. Individual pages keep their images in full color. On unless switched off.
imageDuotone.title: Duotone Listing Images

showRelatedEvents.description: Shows a grid of upcoming events at the bottom of each event page that share one or more tags or artists with it. Events with the most in common come first, then the soonest. Hidden when there are none. On unless switched off.
showRelatedEvents.title: Show Related Events

colorBackground.description: Overrides the theme's page background color, in both light and dark mode. Leave empty to keep the theme's own color.
colorBackground.title: Background Color

colorPrimary.description: Overrides the theme's main text color, in both light and dark mode. Leave empty to keep the theme's own color.
colorPrimary.title: Primary Color

colorSecondary.description: Overrides the theme's secondary text color, in both light and dark mode. Leave empty to keep the theme's own color.
colorSecondary.title: Secondary Color

colorMuted.description: Overrides the theme's muted text color, in both light and dark mode. Add two extra hex digits for transparency, e.g. #00000066. Leave empty to keep the theme's own color.
colorMuted.title: Muted Color

colorNav.description: Overrides the theme's navigation color, in both light and dark mode. Leave empty to keep the theme's own color.
colorNav.title: Navigation Color

colorTint.description: Used on listing images and homepage featured events. Leave empty to use the primary text color.
colorTint.title: Image Tint Color
